paragraphs.source_en:
The draft in Box 1, f. 38v reverso appears to read Are won, although a variant on f. 33v does read
When moonlight & music & feeling are one. ‘Won’ in context makes for a possible reading (‘won’ in
the sense of ‘earned’); perhaps S. in his draft was experimenting with the effect of the homophone on
the sense.
